title: poa trivialis subsp. feratiana
intro: Poa trivialis subsp. feratiana, commonly known as Alpine Timothy Grass, is a subspecies of the perennial grass Poa trivialis. This plant is known for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving respiratory conditions such as bronchitis and asthma. The therapeutic actions of Poa trivialis subsp. feratiana include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant properties, which help to soothe and calm the body. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and other phenolic compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
